Best in Industry / As per experience

**Job Summary**

Daccess IT Infra Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a driven and target\-oriented Business Development Executive to grow its ELV (CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm, PA, Networking, AV, BMS, etc.) and IT Infrastructure business. The role owns the complete sales cycle — from lead generation (cold calling, LinkedIn outreach, referrals), through preparing technical\-commercial quotations, to client meetings, negotiation, and deal closure. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who is comfortable with outbound prospecting and consultative, solution\-based selling of technical systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Generate new business leads through cold calling, LinkedIn outreach/InMail, email campaigns, referrals, and networking events.
* Identify and map target accounts (corporates, hospitals, hotels, educational institutes, government bodies, industries, residential/commercial builders) for ELV and IT infra requirements.
* Qualify leads and understand client requirements (CCTV, access control, networking, fire alarm, AV, BMS, structured cabling, data centre, etc.).
* Coordinate with the technical/pre\-sales team to prepare accurate BOQs, technical specifications, and commercial quotations.
* Schedule and conduct client meetings/site visits, deliver product/solution presentations and demos.
* Negotiate commercial terms, follow up persistently, and close sales to achieve monthly/quarterly targets.
* Build and maintain strong long\-term relationships with clients, consultants, architects, and channel partners for repeat and referral business.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, pipeline, follow\-ups, and closures in CRM/Excel; submit regular MIS/sales reports to management.
* Coordinate with the project/operations team post\-sale to ensure smooth handover, delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Track competitor activity, market pricing, and emerging technology trends in the ELV/IT infrastructure space.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication, and confident client\-facing presentation skills.
* Strong cold\-calling, LinkedIn prospecting, and lead\-generation ability; not hesitant about outbound outreach.
* Ability to understand technical ELV/IT products well enough to explain solutions and prepare quotations independently or with light technical support.
* Good negotiation, follow\-up discipline, and a closing mindset — comfortable being measured on targets/incentives.
* Working knowledge of MS Office/Excel, email, and CRM tools; LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus.
* Willingness to travel locally for client meetings and site visits; two\-wheeler/valid license preferred.

**Educational Qualification – Recommendation**

Preferred background: Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, EXTC, Computer, or IT, since it helps in understanding ELV/networking specifications and preparing accurate technical quotations without depending entirely on the pre\-sales team. An MBA (Sales/Marketing) is a strong added advantage on top of this, especially for client handling and negotiation, but is not mandatory by itself.

**Suggested Designation**

Recommended title: "Business Development Executive – ELV \& IT Infrastructure Solutions." This is clear to the market, signals the technical\-sales nature of the role, and is the standard title used by peer system\-integrator companies for this profile (lead generation \+ quotation \+ closing).

* If hiring a fresher/trainee: Business Development Associate / Trainee – BD
* If hiring a senior/experienced closer with a client book: Business Development Manager, or Assistant Manager – Business Development

**Career Growth Path**

BD Associate/Executive → Senior BDE → Assistant Manager – BD → Business Development Manager → Head of Sales / AVP – Business Development, based on target achievement, client relationships built, and leadership capability.

**Openings \& Hiring Details**

* Number of openings: 2\-3
* Notice period preference: Immediate to 30 days
* Industry preference: ELV/Security Systems, IT Infrastructure, Networking, AV, or related B2B technical sales
* Gender/other preferences: Open

title: Insights and Analytics Business Analyst
description:
At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we create it. Embark on a transformative journey as part of the Insights and Analytics Business Analyst, where you’ll play a pivotal role to support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities. Your primary responsibility includes undertaking insights and analytics to support business performance and improvement through high\-quality data insights.
   

  

 Ensure comprehensive, timely, and accurate operational oversight for teams, senior leadership, service buyers, auditors and regulators.
   

  

 Design, produce and maintain clear, articulate \& insightful reporting to best deliver outputs and derived insights to internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

 Track, manage and govern proactive and reactive data validations for all Critical Data Elements across business areas.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with Product owner, technology teams and business to provide input during development and implementation phases, including formulation and definition of systems scope, objectives and necessary system enhancements for complex, high\-impact projects.
   

  

 Identify and communicate risks and impacts and propose risk mitigation options, considering business implications of the application of technology to the current business environment. Provide in\-depth and sophisticated analyses with interpretive thinking to define problems, develop innovative solutions and influence strategic functional decision.10\+ years of professional experience with indicated skill set.
   

  

**To be successful as an Insights and Analytics Business Analyst, you should have experience with:**
* Requirements Gathering \& Process Modelling – Expertise in eliciting, documenting, and validating business requirements; creating user stories, functional specifications, workflow diagrams, process maps, and impact assessments using BA methodologies and best practices.
* Business Intelligence \& Dashboarding Tools \- Strong experience with tools such as Power BI, Excel (Advanced), App Insights Workbooks, Tableau, and analytics platforms to design dashboards, monitor technology performance, and present insights to stakeholders in a meaningful way.
* Technology \& Digital Platform Understanding – Working knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Viva, Power Platform, APIs, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, and cloud\-based solutions enabling effective collaboration between business and engineering teams.
* Agile Delivery \& Product Tooling – Hands\-on knowledge of Jira, Azure , Confluence, Scrum, Kanban, and Agile delivery frameworks to support backlog management, sprint planning, prioritization, and traceability from requirements through to implementation.
* Technical Business Analysis \-Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, define KPIs, create data models, perform root\-cause analysis, and partner effectively with engineering, architecture, and product teams.
* Data Governance \& Quality Management – Understanding of data lineage, data quality frameworks, controls, privacy, and governance principles to ensure trusted and compliant insights.
* Strategic Problem Solving \& Continuous Improvement – Ability to identify opportunities, define KPIs, measure outcomes, and recommend data\-driven improvements that enhance colleague experience, operational efficiency, and business value.
* Stakeholder Management \& Communication – Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes, produce executive\-ready reports and presentations, facilitate workshops, and influence decision\-making across technology, product, and business teams.


**Some Of Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Candidates with experience in expertise in Data Analytics \& Insight Generation – Ability to transform complex data into clear business insights, identify trends, measure outcomes, and create compelling narratives that influence strategic decision\-making. Ability to analyze data, identify trends, measure business outcomes, and convert findings into actionable recommendations.
* Business Intelligence \& Visualization Expertise – Strong proficiency in tools such as Power BI, Tableau, App Insights, Data Fabric workbooks to build executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and actionable reporting.
* Agile Delivery \& Product Management – Experience working within Agile environments and Sprints.
* Awareness of Azure environment.
* Flexible with working hours as the wider team is across geo locations.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location of the role is Pune, IN.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

* Move heavy computational logic to the database layer via stored procedures and functions where appropriate to reduce application\-layer overhead.

title: Junior Financial Data Analyst – E-Commerce (Tally + Excel)
description:
**About Headphone Zone**

We are **Headphone Zone** (www.headphonezone.in), India’s premier e\-commerce brand for high\-end audio gear. Because we process thousands of orders daily across multiple platforms, **90% of our accounting system is automated, cloud\-driven, and data\-focused**.

We sit at the intersection of e\-commerce data and finance. Instead of manual ledger typing, our daily operations rely on smart data reconciliation, spreadsheet logic, and Tally integration.

**Freshers \& Data Enthusiasts Welcome!**

You don't need years of audit or legacy accounting experience. If you are a **Data Analyst, Science/Engineering/Commerce graduate, or spreadsheet wizard** with a strong numerical IQ, a solid understanding of basic accounting principles, and working knowledge of Tally Prime, we want to hear from you! We will train you on our specific e\-commerce workflows and automated systems.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Data Handling \& Cleaning:** Process, clean, and reconcile large datasets (sales reports, return logs, payment gateway settlements) using Excel / Google Sheets.
* **Tally Data Integration:** Format and import automated cloud data streams into **Tally Prime** and verify ledger balances.
* **Discrepancy Investigation:** Spot patterns, identify data mismatches, and track inventory movements across systems.
* **AI \& Workflow Optimization:** Use AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) to write complex formulas, automate repetitive data tasks, and solve logical reporting issues.

**Who You Are (Qualifications \& Skills)**

* **Data \& Spreadsheet Proficiency:** Strong command over Excel or Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, logical formulas, CSV handling).
* **AI \& Tech Agility (Major Plus):** Active inclination to use tools like **Gemini, Claude, or ChatGPT** to speed up analysis, write formulas, or troubleshoot data issues.
* **Basic Tally Knowledge:** Working familiarity or practical knowledge of Tally Prime.
* **Core Accounting Logic:** Understanding of core accounting principles, financial statements, and double\-entry fundamentals (debit/credit logic).
* **Background:** Open to any analytical degree (B.Sc, BCA, B.Tech, B.Com, BBA).

**Location \& Work Hours**

* **Location:** Must reside in Chennai, preferably within a **30\-minute daily commute** to our **Adyar** office.
* **Full\-Time:** 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM
* **Part\-Time:** 9:30 AM – 1:30 PM **OR** 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM (Pro\-rata pay)
* **Work\-Life Balance:** We strictly respect work hours—we **never** have delayed or extended office hours.
* *(Note: This is a strictly in\-office role; there is no WFH option).*

title: Intern- Human Resources
description:
****RSA \- Inter, Human Resources****
 RSA provides trusted identity and access management for 12,000 organizations around the world, managing 25 million enterprise identities and providing secure, convenient access to millions of users. RSA specializes in empowering security\-first organizations in financial services, healthcare, energy, technology services, and other industries to thrive in a digital world, delivering complete capabilities for modern authentication, access, lifecycle management, and identity governance. Whether in the cloud or on\-premises, RSA connects people with the digital resources they depend on everywhere they live, work, and play.
   

  

 For decades, RSA has pioneered many of the encryption, authentication, and identity federation technologies that still power the internet. And now RSA is transforming the industry yet again, paving the way for the future of digital identity through the RSA Unified Identity Platform; next\-generation hybrid and cloud solutions; the first ever and only multi\-functional, passwordless hardware authenticator; and a frictionless, mobile\-optimized experience for the modern workforce. If you are self\-motivated and looking for a fast\-paced challenge doing something that truly matters, come join our winning team! For more information, go to rsa.com.

title: Global Data Steward - Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As part of the Data team within HR, the BCG Global Data Stewards are responsible for the design and implementation of an enterprise\-wide Data Governance strategy that supports the efficient usage of data across the firm by ensuring key sets of fully governed, curated, and globally integrated data products \& assets.

  

Under the guidance of the Global Data Owner, each Global Data Steward supports key data initiatives (both functional and technical) in the domain, including defining and executing principles, harmonized definitions, quality assessments, and governance processes to ensure safe usage and evolution of enterprise\-wide products and assets.

  

Specifically, the Learning Data Steward will develop a data governance strategy for BCG’s Learning data domain. This role will first be embedded within a Learning Transformation project, working to ensure that Learning data governance aligns with broader transformation objectives. You will collaborate with HR, Data, and Enterprise Services leaders, as well as their corresponding Business Intelligence, Operations, and Technology teams, to ensure a strong, compliant, and strategically valuable Learning data ecosystem. After the transformation, this role will continue to maintain data governance as the number of data sources increases/changes and new data use\-cases are identified.

  

The ideal candidate will have a goal\-oriented mindset and enjoy working with cross\-functional teams to deliver Data Governance capabilities and support exceptional Data Products. They will have 8\+ years of experience in Data Governance (preferably in Learning, or HR data), and be well\-versed in in common data opportunities in these areas. Additionally, they should have strong communication skills with proven experience in stakeholder engagement, including working with senior business and technical teams to showcase the business benefits of Data Governance.

 **Among your responsibilities, you will:**

 **Define an overall vision, roadmap, and priorities for our Learning Data Governance Strategy**

  

* Work closely with the Global HR Data Governance Director, the HR Data Owner, and other Global Data Stewards (e.g., Worker data) to develop a Learning data strategy
* Understand end\-to\-end Learning data flows across BCG, and Learning platforms
* Understand Learning data opportunities from our data consumers and business leads, especially our BI\&A, and HR stakeholders. Work to define an overall strategy and roadmap for the Learning data, including a set of initiatives with clear accountabilities, goals and objectives ensuring efficient Data Governance capability implementation.
* Align the Learning Data Governance strategy with broader BCG HR, and Data leadership priorities
* Create and enforce data quality policies and standards to maintain compliance and support decision\-making
* Ensure that data structures, processes, and governance mechanisms support Learning Transformation objectives
* Work with HR Technology and IT teams to integrate governance controls into new Learning systems and platforms

 **Ensure sustainable delivery of customer value on the agreed Data Governance roadmap**

  

* Collaborate with other Global Data Stewards and IT teams to ensure consistency across BCG’s Data Governance strategy
* Ensure that areas of priority are identified (e.g. Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Quality) and a cohesive action plan is developed to ensure impactful value\-add to end customers
* Clear narrative and articulation of Data Governance principles linked to business value\-add, communicating these regularly to senior stakeholders across Data and HR.
* Track and report on specific and measurable aligned KPIs and key results, developing metrics to measure maturing with Learning data
* Prioritise identified data opportunities clearly communicating with required stakeholders to ensure efficient delivery
* Proactively identify and escalate risks and mitigation plans, along with key decisions, to relevant stakeholders
* Foster collaboration with Learning, HR, and Data teams to ensure alignment on data opportunities and priorities

 **Engage with the Data Governance community to ensure alignment and best practices**

  

* Collaborate with other Global Data Stewards and data teams to ensure consistency across BCG’s Data Governance strategy
* Foster collaboration with Learning, HR, and Data teams to ensure alignment of data opportunities and priorities
* Provide training and guidance on Learning data best practices, compliance, and governance frameworks

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data, HR, or related fields
* 5\+ years of experience working in data\-related or project roles (e.g. Data Management, Data Governance, CDO Office or BI \& Analytics team). Prior experience working with Learning data is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of total Learning data concepts, and other HR concepts including compliance
* An understanding of Data Governance industry best practice is useful (such as DAMA’s DMBoK \& CDMP, EDM Council’s DCAM)
* Understanding of data strategy and management concepts and associated business processes and tools, including Data Modelling, Data Warehousing, and Data Quality
* Hands\-on experience using Data Governance tools such as Data Catalogs (e.g. Talend Data Catalog) and Data Quality Tools
* Experience with Learning systems and/or HR platforms (Snowflake, Workday, etc.)
* Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills to collaborate with diverse, global teams

  

Who You'll Work With

* BCG Global HR and Data teams: the HR Data Product Portfolio, Data Governance CoE, Master Data Mgmt., Enterprise Data Modelling, and Data Product development teams
* BCG HR, and Data teams; business intelligence and analytics, operations, and technical teams, among other business functions
* BCG Leadership: Heads of HR, Learning, and Enterprise Services among other business functions.
* The broader Learning Transformation project team
* The Data Governance network: Data Owners, Stewards, and Data Governance Directors

  

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Defining and implementing a global Learning Data Governance framework and ensuring data quality, security, and compliance
* Understanding Learning data structures, and other BCG data structures
* Leading activities related to the Learning Data Governance strategy, including: Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Master Data mgmt., Data Quality, Data Architecture, and informing Data Product development priorities
* Partnering with HR, and IT teams to prioritize Learning data initiatives.
* Developing Learning data analytics, metrics, and dashboards to track governance maturity
* Ensuring adherence to relevant global and local data policies, regulations, and standards
* Communicating with senior executive teams about the importance of Learning data strategy

 万丰奥特控股集团（以下简称“万丰集团”）创立于1994年，是一家“大交通”领域以先进制造业为核心的国际化企业。一直以来，万丰集团秉持“实业报国、产业强国”的责任使命，遵循“永恒提升价值、不断奉献社会”的理想信念，产业涉足汽车部件、航空工业、智能装备、金融投资等领域，致力于“营造国际品牌、构筑百年企业”。 历经20多年的发展，万丰集团资产超300亿元、员工1\.5万人以上，位列中国民营企业500\*强、中国汽车工业30强、浙江省100强，已形成轻量化应用汽车部件和通用飞机制造“双引擎”驱动的发展格局，打造全球汽车金属部件轻量化推动者和领\*导者、通用飞机创新制造企业的全球领跑者。其中：轻量化铝轮、新材料镁合金产业实现细分市场全球；新工艺涂覆、智能装备工业机器人产业实现细分市场国内；战略性新兴产业通航产业成为全国民企集飞机制造、机场建设、航校培训、通航运营、低空保障、航空俱乐部等于一体全产业链的样板，占地5\.5平方公里的万丰航空小镇已列入国家通用航空综合示范区、国家空中游览基地、国家飞行营地、浙江省特色小镇，所产拥有全部知识产权的钻石通航飞机进入世界品牌前三强。借助上市公司平台，万丰集团朝着行业领\*先、向千亿目标迈进，从经营国际化向资本、人才、科技、品牌国际化转型升级。 步入新发展阶段，贯彻新发展理念，融入新发展格局，万丰集团将牢牢抓住国家大力发展战略性新兴产业的历史机遇，践行《中国制造2025》战略和“国际国内双循环”新发展格局，专注实体经济，弘扬工匠精神，以数字经济为牵引，以实业经营为基础，不断扩大产业规模，带动周边群体共享发展，实现“百强百誉百年万丰”的战略目标，争当浙江省高质量发展共同富裕标杆企业，为振兴地方经济、推动行业进步、促进社会发展贡献万丰更多的智慧和力量。

title: Lead Associate – Performance Management & Learning Excellence
description:
**Lead Associate – Performance Management \& Learning Excellence** 




  





**Practice:** 
 Career Development
 



**Job Title:** 
 Team Lead
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Senior Manager
 



**Experience:** 
 6 \- 8 Years
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an enthusiastic, analytical, and process\-oriented
 **Lead Associate – Performance Management \& Learning Excellence** 
 to own and continuously improve Opteamix's Performance Management System (PMS) and Learning \& Development ecosystem. You will work closely with HR leadership and business leaders to ensure our employees have clear goals, meaningful feedback, structured career development, and continuous learning opportunities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Performance Management** 



* Own and coordinate complete Performance Management lifecycle across the organization.
* Maintain competency frameworks, job descriptions, career roadmaps, and position code documentation.
* Facilitate goal setting using Opteamix's OKR\-based Performance Management framework.
* Manage periodic reviews, continuous feedback, annual appraisals, calibration discussions, and performance closure.
* Monitor adherence to performance review timelines and proactively follow up with stakeholders.
* Support promotion, career progression, and succession planning processes.
* Prepare performance dashboards, analytics, and executive reports for leadership.



**Learning \& Development** 



* Coordinate organizational learning initiatives and annual training calendars.
* Administer and continuously improve the Learning Management System (LMS).
* Track learning participation, certifications, completion, and effectiveness.
* Partner with business leaders to identify competency gaps and learning requirements.
* Coordinate technical, behavioural, leadership, and functional learning programs.
* Measure learning effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or an equivalent qualification.
* 5\+ years of experience in Performance Management, Learning \& Development, HR Operations, or HR Business Partnering, preferably in an IT Services or Technology organization.
* Good understanding of modern Performance Management frameworks, including OKR (Objectives \& Key Results), Continuous Performance Management, Goal Cascading, Competency Frameworks, 360° Feedback, Continuous Feedback, and Career Development frameworks.
* Experience administering or working with HRMS, Performance Management Systems (PMS), Learning Management Systems (LMS), and digital HR platforms.
* Strong analytical capability with advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience in creating dashboards, reports, and leadership presentations.
* Exposure to AI\-powered productivity tools, digital HR transformation initiatives, and process automation will be an added advantage.
* Passion for building high\-performance organizations through people, learning, and continuous improvement.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**Summary/Objective** 




  





 The HR Generalist will play a critical role in supporting Emburse’s growing presence in India, acting as a key liaison between Emburse employees, our local employment partner (PEO) and global People Operations. This role will provide excellent internal customer support to employees and leaders by managing core HR processes and ensuring smooth and efficient operations. The HR Generalist administers day\-to\-day HR programs, maintains compliance, supports engagement, and strengthens the employee experience through consistency, communication, and collaboration maintaining strong alignment between local execution and global standards.
 



  





**Essential Functions** 




  





 Operational Alignment
 


* Act as the primary liaison between Emburse, the local PEO partner (Summit) and India\-based employees, ensuring effective coordination of HR processes and consistent communication.
* Partner closely with the HRBP and local leadership to align on employee needs, business priorities and execution of HR initiatives.
* Coordinate and facilitate HR processes delivered through the PEO (payroll inputs, policy implementation, benefits, etc ), ensuring accuracy and a seamless employee experience.
* Operate effectively within a dual\-employment model, adapting solutions and communication to balance global standards with local execution.
* Provide ongoing insights on employee sentiment, operational risks and cultural dynamics to global stakeholders.
* Act as a cultural bridge between India and global teams, supporting alignment in expectations, communication styles and ways of working.
* Identify potential challenges proactively and recommend solutions that align business objectives with local practices and cultural context.



  





 Human Resources Operations
 



  




* Serve as the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR\-related topics, providing guidance, support and timely resolution of queries, in coordination with the PEO.
* Manage employee relations matters, including conflict resolution investigations, and documentation in partnership with HRBPs.
* Own and improve onboarding processes, ensuring role\-specific and function\-specific onboarding experiences.
* Support and execute performance management processes.
* Act as a primary point of co\-ordination for employees without local reporting lines, ensuring they remain engaged and supported.
* Drive employee engagement and culture initiatives locally, fostering a connected, inclusive and high\-performing work environment. Identify gaps in employee experience and proactively design and implement solutions.
* Support employees across multiple functions (engineering, implementation, support, business systems, etc), particularly those working with globally distributed teams without local management.
* Act as an ambassador of Emburse values, promoting a consistent employee experience aligned with global standards.



 Compliance
 


* Ensure all HR practices and processes are compliant with Indian labor laws and regulatory requirements, in coordination with the PEO.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records, ensuring proper documentation and data integrity.
* Support audits, compliance checks, and reporting requirements as needed.



  





  





 Education and Experience
 



  





 Education:
 


* Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, HR, Psychology, Sociology or similar field



  





 Experience:
 



 Preferred: Minimum of 3 years’ experience working in a human resources role in multiple disciplines in SaaS or technology companies.
 



  





  





 Certifications:
 


* Preferred: None



  





 Additional Eligibility Qualifications
 



 Required Skills:
 


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Ability to communicate effectively, clearly and concisely both verbally and in writing
* Excellent follow\-up skills and operates with a sense of urgency
* Builds and maintains effective relationships with co\-workers and customers
* Strong organizational skills and ability to work autonomously
* Possess strong technological skills to perform data entry, manage schedules/calendars
* Comprehensive working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint and Google Suite
* Proactive, accountable, resourceful, detail\-oriented
* Ability to self\-manage competing priorities successfully

title: Junior Manager, HR Operations
description:
**Job Description**
 About Us :
   

  

 With over 200 brands sold in more than 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. Every day, over 27,000 talented people come together at Diageo to create the magic behind our much\-loved brands.
   

  

 Our founders, such as Arthur Guinness, John Walker, and Charles Tanqueray, were visionary entrepreneurs whose brilliant minds helped shape the alcohol industry. And through our people, their legacy lives on. Join us, and you’ll collaborate with talented people from all corners of the world. Together, you’ll innovate and push boundaries, shaping a more inclusive and sustainable future that we can all be proud of.
   

  

 With diversity at our core, we celebrate our people's individual passions, commitments and specialist skills. In our supportive culture, your voice will be heard and you’ll be empowered to be you. Just bring your ambition, curiosity and ideas, and we’ll celebrate your work and help you reach your fullest potential.
   

  

**About Global HR Operations And First Point**
 Global HR Operations provides reliable, consistent and high\-quality HR services to employees, line managers and HR colleagues across supported markets. First Point is the primary HR service organisation within this model, combining specialist HR knowledge, strong process discipline and enabling technology to deliver an excellent customer experience.
   

  

 The team supports a broad range of employee lifecycle services, including Joiners, Movers and Leavers (JML), employee and position data management, HR documentation, benefits administration, policy guidance and resolution of HR and HR systems queries. Work is delivered through platforms including Workday, ServiceNow and Doc Genie, with a strong focus on accuracy, compliance, service performance and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 The Junior Manager, HR Operations is a senior operational contributor who supports the Team Leader in delivering consistent day\-to\-day service performance. The role combines hands\-on ownership of complex HR transactions and queries with workload oversight, subject\-matter expertise, stakeholder engagement, advisor capability building and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The role acts as an escalation point for complex employee lifecycle, documentation, data and systems matters; helps ensure the team is appropriately prioritised and resourced; and provides practical insights that enable the Team Leader to manage performance, risk and customer experience effectively.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Service Delivery and Operational Performance
* Deliver HR services in line with agreed service levels, quality standards and customer experience measures, including speed to resolution, right\-first\-time accuracy and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor team workload, case distribution and progress against agreed priorities; identify risks, backlogs or under\-performance and recommend timely mitigation actions to the Team Leader.
* Maintain clear and complete ServiceNow case notes, supporting documentation and audit trails.
* Support workforce planning by maintaining visibility of planned and unplanned absence and helping ensure appropriate coverage for business\-as\-usual, cyclical activity and projects.
* Employee Lifecycle, Documentation and Data
* Execute and oversee complex Joiner, Mover and Leaver transactions in Workday, ensuring employee and position data is complete, accurate and processed right first time.
* Create, review, approve and issue accurate employee documentation, including contracts, letters and other lifecycle communications, in line with market requirements and governance standards.
* Coordinate required payroll instructions and downstream actions, ensuring critical dates, approvals and dependencies are understood and completed.
* Act as a Workday super user and provide practical support on employee data, organisation management and position management activities.
* Complex Query and Escalation Management
* Take ownership of complex process, policy, documentation, data and systems issues escalated by the Contact Centre, HR teams or advisors, leading them through investigation to resolution.
* Apply sound judgement, market knowledge and policy interpretation while engaging the appropriate stakeholders when specialist or approval input is required.
* Capture root causes and learning from escalations and translate them into clearer guidance, stronger controls or capability interventions.
* Market Partnership and Subject\-Matter Expertise

title: Factory HR Manager
description:
**About Us** 




 Toram Creators is a knitwear manufacturer with production units at Tiruppur and Vadipatti. Our Vadipatti unit is an active factory floor with a diverse workforce — and we need the right person to keep it running smoothly from a people and compliance standpoint.
 



  





**What This Role Is** 




 This is a hands\-on factory HR role. You will be on the floor as much as you are at your desk. You will know every worker by face, manage their records with accuracy, handle recruitment for floor\-level positions, and ensure the unit stays fully compliant with labour laws.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment for factory floor positions — sourcing, screening and onboarding workers and supervisors.
* Maintain accurate attendance, leave and overtime records for all factory staff.
* Ensure full statutory compliance — EPF, ESI, Factories Act, Contract Labour Act, minimum wages, and all applicable labour regulations.
* Manage all labour\-related documentation: registers, notices, licences, inspection readiness.
* Handle day\-to\-day worker grievances on the floor — with firmness, fairness and discretion.
* Support payroll inputs — attendance data, deductions, overtime — for processing.
* Ensure the factory maintains ongoing readiness for social and ethical compliance audits — including
 **SEDEX, WRAP** 
 and any buyer\-mandated audits.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 3–6 years of HR experience in a factory or manufacturing environment — garments preferred, open to textiles, FMCG or similar.
* Solid working knowledge of labour laws, EPF, ESI, Factories Act and Contract Labour regulations.
* Comfortable on the factory floor.
* Someone with people sense: firm when needed, approachable always.
* Any graduation; MBA / MSW / PG in HR or Labour Welfare is an advantage.
* Willing to be based full\-time at Vadipatti, Madurai district.

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Analyst, Global Product Enablement
   

  

**Overview**
 The Global Product Enablement team is seeking an Analyst of Global Product Enablement to support the successful, consistent, and scalable integration of new or significantly enhanced solutions. The ideal candidate is curious, analytical, organized, collaborative, and motivated to learn how products are enabled for global customer delivery teams. This role is well suited for someone who can support cross\-functional initiatives, help translate product and implementation information into clear documentation and enablement materials, and contribute to process improvements that support speed, quality, and predictability.
   

  

 This position requires strong communication, attention to detail, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Regional Delivery, and other Mastercard teams. The person in this role will support senior team members in preparing delivery documentation, coordinating enablement activities, gathering feedback, tracking actions, and helping ensure delivery teams have the knowledge, tools, and resources needed to support customer onboarding.
   

  

* Are you curious about how new products and services are prepared for customer delivery?
* Do you want to build a global perspective and learn how Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams work together?
* Are you passionate about improving processes, documentation, and the customer onboarding experience?
* Are you comfortable working with data, feedback, and stakeholder input to identify trends and improvement opportunities?
* Do you enjoy collaborating with others, learning new concepts, and turning complex information into clear, practical materials?


 The Global Product Enablement (GPE) team is part of the Global Customer Delivery \& Care organization. Focusing on new products and services, the Global Product Enablement team collaborates with product owners, development teams, and other stakeholders across Mastercard to deploy solutions efficiently and effectively with speed, quality, and predictability. GPE supports Regional Customer Delivery teams by developing the necessary processes, documentation, tools, and knowledge resources to scale products and solutions at an accelerated pace. GPE creates streamlined and straightforward processes used globally by our delivery teams, resulting in a positive implementation experience for both customers and employees. Additionally, GPE supports product readiness and the implementation of key frameworks by our partners to provide best\-in\-class customer experience, utilizing key data, insights, and feedback for continual improvement.
   

  

 Role \& responsibilities
   

  

* Support discussions with Global Product and Engineering owners by helping capture delivery requirements, actions, decisions, and regional feedback needed to support Studio Framework Excellence and product integration readiness.
* Support low to medium complexity initiatives by coordinating tasks, tracking progress, preparing materials, and escalating risks or open questions as needed.
* Partner with regional delivery teams to help provide the knowledge, support, tools, processes, and documentation needed to perform their job functions efficiently and effectively.
* Assist in preparing and maintaining training materials, implementation guides, process documentation, task lists, and knowledge resources for regional customer delivery teams.
* Help coordinate product enablement activities, including meeting preparation, action tracking, follow\-ups, and readiness checkpoints.
* Support product integration efforts through the global Studio process in collaboration with global product owners, technology teams, and other stakeholders.
* Contribute to the ongoing improvement of GPE standards, methodology, documentation quality, and ways of working.
* Assist with collecting, organizing, and analyzing feedback, data, and insights to identify opportunities to improve the customer onboarding and delivery experience.
* Collaborate with partners across Mastercard to support integrated, automated, and scalable tools and reporting that enhance delivery efficiency and customer experience.


**All About You**
* Foundational experience or strong interest in payments, processing, customer delivery, implementation, product enablement, or related business operations.
* Basic understanding of the payment ecosystem, product lifecycle, customer onboarding, and hand\-offs across Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Support teams.
* Experience supporting projects, initiatives, process improvements, documentation, training, or operational readiness activities.
* Ability to understand, organize, simplify, and clearly communicate business and technical information.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset, and ability to follow through on actions and commitments.
* Comfortable working in a matrixed, global organization with multiple stakeholders and changing priorities.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to collect information, identify patterns, and propose practical improvements.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to create clear documentation and support enablement or training activities.
* Ability to build positive working relationships with internal teams, business partners, and stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
* Curious about technology and motivated to learn new products, processes, tools, and ways of working.
* Team player with a willingness to share knowledge, ask questions, and support others.
* Self\-starter who can work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance when needed.
* Experience with project coordination, process documentation, data analysis, or reporting tools is a plus.
* Project management exposure or certification is a plus, such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar.
* Process improvement exposure, such as Lean, Six Sigma, SAFe, or similar, is a plus.
* Language skills are a plus, as the role works with regional teams.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Demand Planning Data Scientist
description:
**Job Description**
**Integrated Business Planning (IBP)** 
 brings together forecasting and planning across marketing, sales, finance, procurement, manufacturing, and customer service into a unified process. This integration ensures alignment across the enterprise, leading to superior customer outcomes.
   

  

 As a
 **Demand Planning Data Scientist** 
 , you will build statistical models and deliver insights to guide business decisions related to demand forecasting that provide reliable and accurate signals for inventory and supply plans. You will partner closely with an IBP demand planner(s) to generate reliable forecasts so they can coordinate demand reviews. These roles in collaboration together will be crucial in ensuring effective demand schedules, streamlining internal processes, and ultimately enhancing the customer experience.
   

  

**Principle Duties/Responsibilities:**
* Develop Statistical Forecasts: Lead the development and implementation of predictive models to forecast product orders across various geographies. Utilize historical data, machine learning, market intelligence, and field sales input to create highly accurate demand forecasting models.
* Assist Demand Planner(s) with Root Cause Analysis: Investigate key metrics such as forecast accuracy, bias, and value add to identify underlying issues.
* Evaluate IBP Deviations: Collaborate with Demand Planners to discuss and understand the impact of last month's Integrated Business Planning (IBP) deviations on the current month's plan.
* Generate Analytical Insights: Theorize potential insights, design and execute experiments to validate model performance and improve forecasting accuracy.
* Communicate Analytical Gains: Articulate the benefits of productionizing statistical models to business functions that can leverage the results of analytical processes.
* Create and Validate Statistical Models: Develop statistical models to test hypotheses and ensure they can be productionized for regular use, allowing for consistent sharing of analysis results. Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business decisions.
* Model Complex Organizational Problems: Use statistical, algorithmic, mining, and visualization techniques to uncover insights and identify opportunities within complex organizational challenges.
* Educate on New Approaches: Inform and educate the organization on innovative analytical approaches and methodologies.
* Identify Data Science Opportunities: Recognize problems that would benefit from Data Scientist expertise. Communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders through clear and compelling visualizations and reports.
* Strategic Data Recommendations: Provide strategic recommendations on data collection, integration, and retention requirements, incorporating business needs and best practices. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate data\-driven strategies into business planning processes.
* Drive Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated with the latest advancements in data science and machine learning to continuously enhance our forecasting capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Typically, at least 1\-2\+ years of experience in data science or equivalent work experience.
* Extensive knowledge in predictive modeling, machine learning, and statistical analysis.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL.

description:
**About Servify:** 




 Servify is a global product lifecycle management platform transforming the after\-sales service experience. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in India, Servify connects leading OEM brands with their sales and service ecosystems to deliver seamless customer support and service operations. Servify partners with leading brands, retailers, distributors, insurers, service providers, and carriers across Asia, North America, Europe, and the MENA region.
 



  





 Servify embraces and values diversity and is committed to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all members and will give equal consideration to all irrespective of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief.
 



  





**Why Join Servify?** 




 At Servify, you'll be part of a fast\-growing global technology company that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. We offer competitive compensation, ESOPs, employee\-friendly policies, modern collaboration tools, professional development opportunities, and benefits that help you do your best work.
 



  





**Position Summary:** 
 We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist to take operational ownership of predictive analytics and algorithmic models within our established data ecosystem. If you have 2\-4 years of data science experience and Databricks in a production environment, this is your chance to drive a critical platform transformation. This role provides significant autonomy. You will be responsible for the continuous health of our production machine learning pipelines, ensuring data quality, statistical model fidelity, and leading the charge to leverage advanced
 



 analytical assets directly inside Databricks SQL Analytics and Warehouse to support intelligent business decisions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Model Stabilization \& Management: Manage, monitor, and ensure the 24/7 operational reliability and accuracy of our current suite of production Databricks (PySpark/Delta Lake) predictive models and analytical pipelines. You are directly responsible for model operational health.
* Data \& Feature Fidelity: Maintain and iterate on complex feature extraction processes structured around the Medallion Architecture. Guarantee the statistical integrity and performance of analytical data features moving from Bronze to Gold layers
* Predictive Insights Lead: Execute the end\-to\-end integration of machine learning outputs and predictive logic onto the native Databricks visualization platform and SQL Analytics warehouses. This is a core focus area.
* Source System Integration for Analytics: Design and optimize training data ingestion logic for diverse data sources, with specific responsibility for extracting, transforming, and loading analytical training sets efficiently from PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
* Partner Insights Sharing \& Security: Establish and govern secure, reliable mechanisms for sharing finalized Databricks machine learning outputs, data visualizations, and predictive metrics with both internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Cost \& Model Performance Optimization: Actively tune distributed machine learning tasks, cluster configurations, and Delta table structures to drive down cloud computing costs and minimize model scoring latency.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 2\-4 years' experience in building, evaluating, and managing robust machine learning models and predictive infrastructure.
* Databricks: Recent hands\-on production experience in managing analytics jobs, compute clusters, and data feature assets within the Databricks environment.
* Expert proficiency in Python (PySpark/Pandas/Scikit\-Learn) and advanced SQL. You should be comfortable working extensively with Databricks notebooks and ML flow terminals.
* Database Expertise: Proven ability to connect to, query, and efficiently extract large datasets from PostgreSQL (Postgres DB) \& MongoDB to generate clean structures for analytical model training (Understanding of NoSQL schema and extraction methods is key).
* Architecture \& Methodology: Practical experience working with data engineered under the Medallion Data Architecture to pull features cleanly for predictive scoring.
* BI Tool Knowledge: Prior exposure to dashboards (such as Tableau or Databricks SQL Analytics/Warehouse) is essential for mapping historical metrics to forward\-looking predictive metrics.

title: Junior Applied AI Engineer
description:
**About SpotDraft**
 SpotDraft is on a mission to help legal and business teams move faster, together. Our AI\-powered contracting platform is redefining how companies manage contracts, and our story deserves to be told in creative, human, and memorable ways.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 SpotDraft is revolutionizing legal operations with AI\-powered tools that help legal teams work faster and smarter. Our flagship products leverage cutting\-edge LLM technology to automate routine legal work and accelerate contract review.
   

  

 Sidebar is an AI\-powered team of legal assistants that handles routine legal work—from contract analysis and legal research to compliance tracking and drafting SpotDraft. It tackles everything beyond contracts, including policy questions, regulatory compliance, and strategic advice SpotDraft, learning from your organization's knowledge to become a specialized legal co\-pilot.
   

  

 VerifAI is an AI contract review tool that works as a Microsoft Word add\-in, helping legal teams review contracts up to 70% faster with SpotDraft. It uses generative AI to check contracts against personal or organizational guidelines and answer open\-ended questions SpotDraft, automatically flagging deviations and suggesting improvements.
   

  

****The Role****
 As a Junior Applied AI Engineer, you'll help build and maintain the production AI systems powering our legal\-tech products. Working alongside senior engineers, you'll contribute to distributed AI services that process large volumes of legal documents, support multi\-agent architectures, and help optimize LLM performance for accuracy, speed, and cost in our mission\-critical SaaS environment.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
**Build AI Features**
* Implement and iterate on AI features using transformer\-based architectures and prompt engineering for legal document workflows (summarization, clause extraction, document comparison, drafting assistance)
* Contribute to agentic systems (ReAct\-style flows, tool/function calling, multi\-turn reasoning) under the guidance of senior engineers
* Write and refine prompts, and help maintain prompt libraries and versioning


**Support RAG \& Context Systems**
* Help build and maintain retrieval pipelines: chunking strategies, hybrid search (BM25 \+ dense embeddings), and reranking for legal documents
* Assist in building retrieval\-grounded generation pipelines and tuning context window usage
* Work with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector) to support semantic search features


**Contribute to Infrastructure \& Performance**
* Help build and maintain API services that call LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini), including retry logic, rate limiting, and fallback handling
* Support inference optimization efforts: caching, batching, and monitoring latency/cost
* Write clean, tested, production\-grade Python code within existing service architectures


**Support Quality \& Reliability**
* Help build evaluation scripts and test datasets to measure model output quality (accuracy, hallucination rate, relevance)
* Assist with LLM\-as\-judge pipelines and human\-in\-the\-loop labeling workflows
* Participate in A/B testing of prompts, models, and configurations


**MLOps \& Observability**
* Support CI/CD pipelines for AI feature deployment (containerization, basic Kubernetes usage)
* Help maintain monitoring dashboards for latency, token usage, error rates, and cost per request
* Assist in debugging production issues using logs, traces, and dashboards


**What We're Looking For**
**Must Have**
* Upto 3 years of experience in software/ML engineering, with at least some hands\-on exposure to LLM\-based systems
* Working experience integrating LLM APIs (GPT\-4, Claude, Gemini, or Llama) — prompt engineering, function calling, or basic fine\-tuning
* Know\-how of context engineering — structuring, trimming, and managing what gets passed into the model's context window across a workflow
* Understanding of agent loops and graphs — how agentic control flow works (e.g. ReAct\-style loops, state graphs, conditional branching between steps/tools)
* Hands\-on experience building agentic workflows — chaining tool calls, managing state across turns, and handling multi\-step reasoning
* Experience building or contributing to eval systems — writing test cases, scoring outputs, and tracking quality/regression over time
* Solid Python skills with an understanding of core software engineering practices (testing, version control, code review)
* Foundational understanding of transformer architectures, embeddings, and how LLMs work
* Some exposure to vector databases and semantic search concepts
* Familiarity with async programming and API frameworks (FastAPI or similar)
* Basic understanding of data structures, algorithms, and complexity
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment and learning quickly from senior engineers and code reviews


**Good to Have**
* Exposure to agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar)
* Exposure to text extraction and text wrangling in current/prior work (parsing PDFs, OCR output cleanup, handling messy or unstructured text)
* Experience with Docker and basic CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Any experience with evaluation frameworks, synthetic test data, or A/B testing for ML systems
* Interest in or coursework related to document/multi\-modal AI (OCR, layout analysis, vision\-language models)
* A personal project, hackathon, or open\-source contribution involving LLMs or RAG systems


**Growth Path**
 This role is designed to grow into a mid\-level/Applied AI Engineer position, with mentorship from senior team members on distributed systems design, advanced RAG architecture, and large\-scale inference optimization.

title: Technical Operations Engineer
description:
**TechOps Engineer I (Site Operations)** 




  





 SRE \& Production Engineering \| Individual Contributor \|Gurugram, India \| Reports to: Head of SRE (via TechOps Shift Lead)
 



**ABOUT AIRTEL MONEY** 




  





 Airtel Money Limited is Bharti Airtel's RBI\-licensed Non\-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), established in February 2026 to build a high\-scale, digital\-first lending platform for India. We bring simple, secure and innovative credit \- personal loans, gold loans and more \- to urban and rural customers through deeply integrated digital channels. Our engineering organisation is built on six first principles: resilience, scalability, redundancy, elasticity, security \& privacy by design, and rapid, safe development.
 



  





**ROLE SUMMARY** 




 As a TechOps Engineer I, you are the first point of action on every production alert. Working a rotating 24×7 shift, you monitor the health of our lending platform, triage alerts the moment they fire, take defined first\-response actions, and escalate cleanly to on\-call engineers when needed. You keep our Tier\-1 services \- origination, underwriting, servicing and collections \- running to their availability targets, and you are the reason a small issue never becomes a customer\-impacting outage.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Act as first responder to alerts from monitoring and security tooling (Grafana, Prometheus, Elastic), acknowledging within SLA and triaging by severity (Sev 1/2/3\).
* Execute documented first\-response runbooks; resolve known issues and escalate the rest to on\-call engineers via the ITSM/Service Now flow with clear, complete context.
* Own the incident ticket lifecycle in Jira \- creation, severity tagging, timeline notes and stakeholder updates — through to closure.
* Monitor dashboards and service health across a rotating 24×7 shift, including nights, weekends and holidays, with a disciplined shift handover.
* Support Sev\-1 war rooms: coordinate communications, track actions, and keep the incident timeline accurate.
* Flag recurring alerts and noise, and contribute improvements to runbooks and monitoring so response gets faster over time.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–2 years in a NOC, TechOps, SRE, production\-support or IT\-operations role.
* Comfort with Linux basics, reading logs, and running defined operational commands.
* Familiarity with monitoring/alerting concepts and ticketing/ITSM tools (Jira or similar).
* Willingness and ability to work rotating 24×7 shifts, and calm, clear communication under pressure.



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Exposure to cloud or container platforms (GCP, Kubernetes, OpenShift) and observability stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, Elastic).
* Basic scripting (Bash or Python) to automate routine checks.
* Understanding of incident\-severity models, on\-call escalation and tools such as PagerDuty.
* Curiosity about fintech, payments or regulated financial systems.



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 Within six months you triage and action alerts confidently against SLA, escalate with context that lets on\-call engineers act immediately, keep incident records audit\-ready, and your shift handovers are reliably clean \- so Tier\-1 services stay healthy on your watch.

title: Analyst I - Cyber Security
description:
**Summary**
 The Cyber Security Analyst I at Westlake is tasked with the administration and oversight of security monitoring tools to protect the IT infrastructure. This role involves proactive daily management of incident tickets, prompt resolution of vulnerabilities, and collaboration with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders to address security compromises. The Analyst I supports complex investigations and remediation efforts across desktops, servers, printers, and network infrastructure equipment, while staying informed about the latest cybersecurity threats and trends.
   

  

 Work Location : Bangalore, India.
   

  

 Shift : 4:30 am \- 1:30 pm
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
*May include, but are not limited to, the following:*
* Administer and tune security monitoring and endpoint/network controls to help maintain a secure computing environment across desktops, servers, printers, and network infrastructure.
* Partner with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to remediate identified vulnerabilities and security compromises, documenting actions and outcomes.
* Maintain and update Cyber Security policies, standards, and procedures, publishing revisions and communicating changes to impacted teams.
* Develop risk\-based security enhancement recommendations and control improvements, presenting options and tradeoffs to IT leadership.
* Triage, manage, and resolve cybersecurity incident tickets, providing timely status updates and a documented resolution summary upon closure.
* Coordinate security audits with IT management and auditors, supporting risk assessments, evidence collection, and remediation tracking through completion.
* Investigate attempted security breaches, identify root causes, and implement or recommend corrective actions to address discovered weaknesses.
* Lead the vulnerability management program by coordinating scans, tracking findings through remediation, facilitating bi\-weekly reviews, and producing status reporting for stakeholders.
* Administer and support critical security systems (Firewalls, Endpoint Security, Intrusion Prevention, Network Access Control, Internet Filtering, Email SPAM Filtering, and phishing exercise products) to ensure effective protection and reliable operations.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation to respond to critical security incidents and urgent issues outside regular business hours, escalating and communicating as needed.
* Perform other related duties as assigned to support Cyber Security and IT operational needs.


**Education, Experience And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT Security, Cyber Security, or a related field is strongly preferred; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
+ A Master’s degree in Cyber Security may substitute for a portion of the required experience, in accordance with company guidelines.


* CISSP and other security certifications are a plus.
* Minimum of 3 years of related Cyber Security experience required.
+ Demonstrated experience in managing and configuring Anti\-Virus solutions, Firewalls, and understanding of network protocols and application security principles.
+ Practical experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions, including monitoring, analyzing, and responding to security events.
+ Proficiency in vulnerability scanning tools and technologies, with the ability to conduct scans, analyze results, and guide remediation efforts.
+ Strong foundation in network and server architecture, with an emphasis on security protocols and best practices.
+ Comprehensive knowledge of the OSI model and its application in troubleshooting and securing network layers.
+ Experience with scripting languages (such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash) to automate security tasks is highly beneficial.
+ Familiarity with forensic analysis techniques and data collection processes for incident response and investigations.


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**
 While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; stand; walk; use hands to touch, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
   

  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
 The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate as normally based in an office. Some of the work may be required in the operating units which can require usage of required PPE including safety glasses, hearing protection, etc. May also result in exposure to outside elements and may require usage of stairs and elevators. Travel including air travel or auto travel may occasionally be required.
   

  

 Westlake offers you the potential to enrich your work life and career experience in an entrepreneurial environment. We work together to enhance peoples lives through our products and presence in the communities in which we operate.
   

  

 Westlake is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristics protected by applicable legislation.

 identified vulnerabilities.

 knowledge\-sharing initiatives.

 :

 • Strong understanding of network protocols, web application architecture, and common

 • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), or similar
 



 certifications preferred.
 



 • Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize and manage
 



 multiple tasks effectively.
 



 • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical
 



 concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 • Proven track record of delivering high\-quality security assessments and actionable

title: Windows System Administrator
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**
 NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform\-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end\-to\-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.
   

  

**🔷 Role Summary**
 We are looking for an entry\-level
 **Server Operations Specialist (L1\)** 
 to support Windows server environments in a global enterprise setup. The role focuses on
 **real\-time monitoring (“eyes on glass”), incident handling, and operational support** 
 across on\-prem and cloud infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring system availability, proactively identifying issues, and coordinating with stakeholders and vendors for timely resolution.
   

  

**🔷 Key Responsibilities**
* Perform 24x7 monitoring of infrastructure systems (eyes on glass) and proactively detect anomalies or alerts
* Lead incident bridge calls, coordinate with internal teams and vendors for issue resolution
* Handle incident/service requests via ServiceNow, ensuring SLA adherence
* Perform initial troubleshooting (L1 level) for Windows servers and escalate when required
* Monitor system health using tools such as AppDynamics (and optionally Splunk)
* Ensure timely communication and updates to stakeholders during incidents
* Support server availability, performance tracking, and alert management using monitoring tools
* Assist in maintaining runbooks, SOPs, and operational documentation
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth service operations


**🔷 Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA
* 1–3 years of experience in server operations / infrastructure monitoring / IT support
* Basic understanding of Windows Server environments
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools
* Exposure to monitoring tools (AppDynamics preferred)
* Good understanding of incident management and escalation processes
* Strong communication skills and ability to work in a global environment
* Ability to respond to alerts and reprioritize tasks dynamically


**🔷 Good To Have Skills**
* Basic knowledge of Splunk or other log analysis tools
* Understanding of VMware / virtualization environments
* Exposure to cloud environments
* Basic understanding of infrastructure components (servers, storage)


**🔷 Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset
* Ability to work under pressure in high\-availability environments
* Team collaboration across global stakeholders
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools and technologies


**🔷 Work Requirements**
* Willingness to work in 24x7 rotational shifts
* Ready to work from office (GCC location)
* Ability to handle critical incidents and high\-priority alerts effectively


**🔷 Success Criteria**
* Timely incident detection and escalation
* Adherence to SLAs and operational KPIs
* Effective coordination during outages
* Reduction in incident resolution time and improved system uptime


 Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

 Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law.
