title: IT Systems & Network Engineer
description:
**About Flam :** 




  





 Flam is an AI\-native content platform building the future of interactive experiences. Our proprietary AI models power four product lines — Flam Instant App (mixed reality advertising), Flam AI Visual Agent (real\-time avatar interactions), Flam Native Ads, and Flowy.ai (AI creative canvas) — serving Fortune 500 brands across the US and India.
 



  





**The Opportunity :** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on IT Admin \& Security Engineer who is equally comfortable setting up a newemployee's MacBook as they are configuring GCP firewall rules. This is a dual\-hat role: you will own the day\-to\-day IT operations for 100\+ employees across two offices — device management, SaaS tool administration,onboarding and offboarding — while simultaneously implementing the technical security controls required for our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification. You will work closely with the GRC Lead and report to the CISO.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  





**Device \& Endpoint Management (Primary) :** 



* Own the full device lifecycle for all 100\+ employees — procurement, configuration, deployment, andsecure disposal of MacBooks and any other endpoints
* Deploy, configure, and maintain an MDM solution (Jamf, Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or equivalent) across all employee devices
* Enforce security policies via MDM: full\-disk encryption, screen lock, automatic OS updates, antivirus/EDR installation, and remote wipe capability
* Maintain a real\-time device inventory in Scrut's Asset Management module — every device tagged with owner, classification, and compliance status
* Conduct and document quarterly MDM compliance audits showing 100% policy enforcement across all devices



**Onboarding \& Offboarding :** 



* Own the technical onboarding checklist — new joiner gets their device configured, all SaaS accounts provisioned, and MFA enrolled before Day 1
* Own offboarding — access revocation across all systems within 24 hours of departure, device retrieval,and remote wipe if required
* Maintain joiners/leavers/movers log as evidence for ISO 27001 A.5\.18 and SOC 2 access control criteria
* Work with HR to ensure zero orphaned accounts — monthly reconciliation of IDP user list against HR active employee records



**Identity \& Access Management :** 



* Administer the Identity Provider (Google Workspace, Okta, or equivalent) — user provisioning, group management, SSO configuration for all SaaS tools
* Enforce MFA across all accounts — export and maintain 100% MFA enrollment report as ongoing audit evidence in Scrut
* Conduct quarterly access reviews across all systems — coordinate with department heads to confirm access is still required for each user
* Manage service account inventory in GCP — ensure all service accounts have named human owners and minimum necessary permissions



**SaaS Tool Administration:** 



* Administer and secure all company SaaS tools — Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Jira, Scrut,and others
* Maintain an approved SaaS tool register — track what tools are in use, who owns them, what data they hold, and their security configuration
* Enforce SSO and MFA on every SaaS tool where the platform supports it
* Identify and remove shadow IT — tools being used by teams without IT awareness or approval



**GCP \& Cloud Security :** 



* Work alongside DevOps to implement and maintain GCP security configurations: VPC firewall rules, IAM policies, org\-level security policies, and Cloud Audit Logs
* Connect GCP and Modal.com to Scrut's Cloud module and maintain automated security posture scanning — track and remediate misconfigurations
* Ensure encryption at rest is enabled on all GCS buckets containing customer data and model weights
* Maintain centralised logging in GCP Cloud Logging — confirm audit logs are enabled across all projects, retained for 12 months, and tamper\-protected
* Run regular vulnerability scans using GCP Security Command Center or equivalent — document findings and track remediation to closure



**Network \& Office Security :** 



* Manage office network security at both the HSR Layout (Bengaluru) office — VLAN segmentation, guest Wi\-Fi isolation, DNS filtering
* Deploy and maintain VPN for remote access to internal systems and production infrastructure
* Configure and maintain web filtering (Cloudflare Gateway or equivalent) covering both office and remote workers
* Maintain network diagrams and data flow diagrams as required by Scrut control AST\-04



**Security Controls \& Audit Evidence :** 



* Own all technical controls in Scrut across the Endpoint Security, Identification \& Authentication, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Asset Management domains — 60\+ controls directly under your remit
* Collect, upload, and maintain evidence in Scrut for every assigned control — screenshots, exports, scan reports, configuration files
* Respond to evidence requests from the GRC Lead and external auditors during ISO 27001 Stage 1/Stage 2 audits and SOC 2 assessment
* Implement and test the remote wipe procedure for lost or stolen devices — document test results as audit evidence



  





**What We're Looking For :** 



* 3–4 years of experience in an IT admin, IT operations, or junior security engineer role
* Hands\-on experience with at least one MDM platform — Jamf, Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or equivalent
* Experience administering Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 at an organisational level — user management, group policies, security settings
* Familiarity with GCP or AWS — comfortable navigating IAM, VPC, storage, and audit log configurations
* Experience with identity providers and SSO — Okta, Google Workspace, Azure AD
* Understanding of endpoint security fundamentals — disk encryption, EDR, antivirus, patch management
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup where you will own problems end\-to\-end without a large team behind you



  





**Nice to Have :** 



* Experience supporting a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit — collecting evidence, responding to auditor requests
* Familiarity with a GRC platform (Scrut.io, Vanta, Drata, or equivalent)
* Google Workspace Administrator certification or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer certification
* Experience with CI/CD security tooling — GitHub Actions security, container image scanning, SAST integration
* Knowledge of network security fundamentals — VLANs, firewall rules, DNS filtering, VPN
* Scripting ability (Python or Bash) for automating IT operations tasks — account provisioning, compliance reporting
* Prior experience at a startup or high\-growth tech company

title: Network Implementation Engineer, Google Enterprise Network
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering or Telecom Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience working with field operation technicians, engineers, contractors, or vendors in a telecommunications environment.
* Experience with Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), firewalls, data center networking, and virtual extensible local area networks (VXLANs).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Professional or expert\-level industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIE, or Google's Professional Cloud Network Engineer certification.
* Familiarity with Data Center Architecture, Wide Area Network (WAN) design, and Wireless Communications.
* Demonstrated ability to manage projects with some complexity, contribute to technical documentation, and mentor junior team members or NOC staff.


**About the job** 
 As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.
   

  

 You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost\-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life\-cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build and operate Google's network reliably and at scale.
* Execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide.
* Develop creative approaches and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to keep operational costs low.

title: Infrastructure Engineer - Network operations
description:
Join us as an “Infrastructure Engineer\-Network operations” at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job\-specific skillsets.
   

  

 To be successful as an “Infrastructure Engineer\-Network operations”, you should have experience with:
   

  

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**
* Strong network fundamentals and troubleshooting: Confident diagnosis across routing/switching, WAN, SD\-WAN, wireless, and edge services; packet\-level analysis; effective decision\-making under pressure.
* Production operations and reliability: Incident and problem management execution, post\-incident reviews, and implementation of controls to prevent recurrence.
* Network technology breadth: Capability across Cisco ACI/Nexus/Catalyst, SD\-WAN, F5 (or equivalent), Fortinet (or equivalent), Infoblox (DNS/DHCP/IPAM), proxy/remote access services, and associated tooling.
* Change governance and risk: Ability to execute production change safely within regulated environments, with strong awareness of audit, risk, and control requirements.
* Automation and scripting: Practical experience using Python and/or Ansible (and related tooling) to automate operational tasks, reduce toil, validate configurations, and improve reliability at scale.


**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**
* Reliability engineering and observability: Experience improving monitoring, alert quality, operational KPIs, and proactive issue prevention.
* Advanced automation and IaC: Exposure to CI/CD patterns for network change, configuration management, testing/validation, and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform) where applicable.
* Hybrid and cloud networking: Working knowledge of cloud connectivity and hybrid patterns (AWS/Azure), including operational troubleshooting across on\-prem and cloud.
* Vendor and service integration: Experience working with vendor\-delivered services under defined operational controls, knowledge transfer, and measurable outcomes.
* Operational excellence: Recognised escalation SME who drives sustained operational improvement through data, controls, and disciplined execution.


 This role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber\-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Fault Management L2 Engineer 1
description:
**Job Description**
 The FM L2 engineer assure End\-to\-end fault/incident \& problem management with main objective of resolution to SLA \& OLA requirements. They solve the higher level of escalation in case of network incidents and are responsible for the resolution, analysis and expertise in case of complex faults that require deep procedural and technical knowledge .
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Level 2 (L2\) support handling advanced monitoring, fault isolation, root\-cause analysis, and restoration. Identification of Key Technical Risks and Issues, develop mitigation plans.
* Preparation of MOP (Method of Procedure) covering Network Changes, Rollback, and Contingency.
* Review and validate network designs, configurations, and change plans before implementation.
* Provide technical guidance during critical network activities and major incidents.
* Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and best practices during execution.
* Support post\-change validation and stability checks.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation of network activities.
* Document technical findings, lessons learned, and improvement actions.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Telecom or equivalent with 5 to 10 years of experience.
* Experience in designing and delivering solutions in IP\-MPLS MP\-BGP solutions: L2VPN, L3VPN.
* Hands\-on experience \& knowledge of Nokia Service Architecture.
* Detailed understanding of Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Segment Routing, MP\-BGP EVPN concepts and related technologies
* Experience in designing and delivering solutions such as BNG.
* Knowledgeable on Network Management Systems, networking concepts and related technologies
* Excellent in designing E2E Mobile Networks, Backhaul and Core Solutions and Concepts.
* Experience with document preparation (HLD and LLD), including configuration preparation for network build \& deployment, troubleshooting, and fault isolation in live environments.


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Experience with following hardware:
* Routing \& Switching: Cisco, HP, Arista FortiGate
* WIFI: Aruba, Cisco
* Firewall: Checkpoint, Cisco ASA, FortiGate, PaloAlto
* Application Delivery Controller: F5 LoadBalancer, Citrix NetScaler, Netskope, Radware
* SD\-WAN: FortiNet, Cisco Catalyst, VMWare Velocloud

* Proven hands\-on L2\-level experience with enterprise networking technologies


 (Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, AWS, Azure, etc.)
   

  

* Familiarity with network security best practices and configurations
* Ability to work in 24x7 shift operations, including night/weekend rotations

* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIS, Fortinet NSE, or equivalent
* Exposure to infra\-audits, compliance processes, and security controls

* Good analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills

 Our Consulting Engineers are an integral part of the Customer Experience (CX) team delivering Lifecycle Services to our customers! As a Consulting Engineer, you will help drive the effort to transform our current and future architecture for our customers. In addition to day\-to\-day customer activities, training and mentoring other engineers will be required. Bring your creative solutions and be an asset to our team!

 Strategic Technical Leadership: Lead high\-priority projects and complex technical solutions. Ensure all deployments are stable, scalable, and fully aligned with the customer’s strategic business goals.

* Apply knowledge of software programmability, automation, and orchestration to streamline workflows. Stay informed on automation and AI trends to improve delivery efficiency.
* Gather lessons learned and best practices to contribute to the team’s repository of reusable templates and standardized materials. Explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Minimum Qualifications –**

* Possess deep technical expertise in 3GPP standards, packet core nodes (S\-GW, P\-GW, MME, SMF, UPF, etc.), StarOS, and Cisco hardware platforms including ASR55k, UCS, and Nexus.
* Demonstrate proficiency in cloud\-native and virtualization technologies—such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and OpenStack—integrated with automation skills in Python, Linux, and AI/ML to enhance network efficiency.
* Deliver comprehensive technical documentation, including high\- and low\-level designs, MOPs, and implementation plans, while performing rigorous software risk, security vulnerability, and network health assessments.
* Act as a primary customer\-facing focal point for proactive problem resolution, utilizing excellent communication skills to engage stakeholders and provide support across both Cisco and third\-party technology ecosystems.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Ability to influence, motivate and work in a highly cross\-functional matrix environment to drive outcomes based plans, programs and execution.
* Hands\-on experience with 5G Packet Core call flows and load testing.
* Proficiency in Cisco products like, ASR55K, StarOS, Ultra\-M, CVIM, CNDP, CPS, UCS.
* Basic knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies. Strong interest in applying AI tools to enhance consulting and delivery outcomes. Associate\-level certification (e.g., CCNA) is expected
* Experience in Cisco delivery for software risk analysis, security vulnerability analysis, network health check reports, internal data base and reviews.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

* Analyze manufacturing processes to identify cycle time reduction opportunities and process optimization initiatives.


**Electrical Automation \& Controls**
* Develop, program, commission, and troubleshoot PLC\-based automation systems using Delta, XINJE, and other industrial PLC platforms.
* Design and develop HMI applications, operator interfaces, machine dashboards, alarm systems, and production monitoring solutions.
* Configure and optimize VFDs, servo drives, stepper drives, and motion control systems for high\-performance machine operations.
* Design, integrate, and validate industrial control systems including sensors, vision systems, safety controls, emergency stop circuits, and machine interlocks.
* Develop electrical panel layouts, wiring schematics, and control architectures in compliance with industrial standards.


**Robotics \& Vision Systems**
* Implement and optimize industrial robotics applications for machine loading/unloading, assembly, pick\-and\-place, and material handling operations.
* Work with robotic platforms such as ABB, FANUC, Yaskawa, and KUKA to enhance manufacturing automation.
* Develop and maintain machine vision systems for quality inspection, defect detection, component verification, barcode scanning, and traceability applications.
* Support collaborative robot (Cobot) integration and advanced robotic automation initiatives.


**Industry 4\.0 \& Smart Manufacturing**
* Lead digital manufacturing initiatives through machine connectivity, IoT integration, data acquisition, and real\-time production analytics.
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards for OEE, MTBF, MTTR, energy consumption, production tracking, quality monitoring, machine utilization, and downtime analysis.
* Implement SCADA systems, cloud\-based monitoring platforms, Andon systems, and predictive maintenance solutions.
* Support smart factory development programs and industrial digitalization initiatives.


**Automation Project Management**
* Conduct feasibility studies and develop technical specifications, automation concepts, and business justifications for automation projects.
* Manage project execution from concept through commissioning, ensuring adherence to budgets, timelines, and quality requirements.
* Coordinate with machine manufacturers, system integrators, vendors, and cross\-functional teams for successful project delivery.
* Lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), installation, commissioning, validation, and qualification activities.
* Establish project documentation standards and ensure smooth project handover to operations and maintenance teams.


**Process Improvement \& Operational Excellence**
* Identify automation opportunities to improve productivity, quality, safety, and manufacturing efficiency.
* Drive lean automation initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, waste elimination, and process standardization.
* Implement error\-proofing (Poka\-Yoke) systems to improve product quality and minimize defects.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing process capability, equipment reliability, and cost optimization.


**Maintenance \& Technical Support**
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, robotics, motion control systems, and industrial automation equipment.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions to improve equipment reliability and uptime.
* Develop preventive maintenance strategies and standards for automation and control systems.
* Provide technical support during equipment breakdowns and critical production issues.


**Safety, Compliance \& Documentation**
* Ensure compliance with machine safety regulations, electrical standards, and industry best practices.
* Perform machine risk assessments and implement safety interlocks, safeguarding systems, and emergency stop circuits.
* Prepare and maintain complete technical documentation, including control logic, electrical schematics, panel layouts, operating procedures, validation records, and project documentation.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, and safety improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.


**Training \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Train operators, technicians, and maintenance teams on automation systems, troubleshooting, and safe operation practices.
* Develop user manuals, troubleshooting guides, and technical training materials.
* Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, and external stakeholders to drive automation and process improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of innovation, automation, continuous improvement, and digital transformation across the organization.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong expertise in PLC, HMI, and SCADA programming, commissioning, and troubleshooting .
* Hands\-on experience with industrial robotics platforms such as ABB, FANUC, Yaskawa, or KUKA .
* Sound knowledge of industrial automation hardware, control systems, sensors, actuators, servo drives, and motion control applications.
* Understanding of industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus, and DeviceNet .
* Familiarity with electrical control panels, pneumatics, hydraulics, and machine control systems.
* Ability to diagnose, optimize, and continuously improve automated manufacturing systems.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD or similar CAD software for electrical and control system design.
* Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting skills, and project execution capabilities.
* Effective communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.


****Core Competencies****
* Automation \& Process Optimization
* Smart Manufacturing Orientation
* Industry 4\.0 Implementation
* Innovation \& Digitalization
* Technical Problem Solving
* Root Cause Analysis
* Project Management \& Execution
* Continuous Improvement Mindset
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Leadership \& Ownership
* Safety \& Quality Excellence
* Result Orientation



**Educational Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in: BE/BTech(E electrical/Mechanical/Mechatronics/Instrumentation Engineering)
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent engineering software is preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.


**Experience**
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in Industrial Automation, Robotics, PLC Programming, Manufacturing Automation, or Machine Integration.
* Experience within manufacturing industries such as engineering products, metal fabrication, automotive components, industrial hardware, or automated production environments will be preferred.


 Note: This job description is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities. Rather, it is intended only to describe the general nature of the job. Employee may be expected to perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
   

  

 As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design\-Trade\-off\-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
   

  

 Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team.Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen.Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering\-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt\- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs\- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware\- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen.
* Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.Kann Support\-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau.
* Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen.Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind.Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter.
* Eine Stelle auf diesem Niveau erfordert gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kann notwendig sein, um ein Junior\-Team zu führen.Entwickelt für kundenorientierte Rollen starke Kundenbeziehungen und dient als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und GE Vernova.Erklärt anderen technische Informationen.


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert grundlegende Erfahrung . Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit entsprechender Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten. Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Product Manager
description:
**Product Manager I (AI Platform)** 




**Full\-time · Bengaluru · On\-site** 




**Experience:** 
 1\+ years
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹6–9 LPA fixed \+ ESOPs of matching value (Total CTC ₹12–18 LPA)
 



  





**About Kasparro** 




 Kasparro builds an AI Visibility platform that helps brands understand and improve how they're represented by AI engines such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI.
 



 As AI increasingly becomes the starting point for product discovery and buying decisions, the quality of a brand's representation inside these systems has become a business problem. We help companies understand how AI models describe them, why those outputs exist, and what changes are most likely to improve them.
 



  





 Our customers range from growing D2C companies to established enterprises across India and the US.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 This is the first Product hire at Kasparro.
 



  





 Today, product thinking, customer investigations, audit design, and product decisions are led by the founder. We're looking for someone who wants to learn this discipline from first principles, not by managing a backlog, but by understanding how AI systems behave and how customers experience them.
 



  





 You'll begin by working on real customer engagements: investigating AI outputs, identifying patterns, validating hypotheses, and developing recommendations backed by evidence. As your understanding deepens, you'll gradually take ownership of product discovery, prioritisation, and specification writing.
 



  





**What you'll work on** 




 Your work will sit at the intersection of AI systems, customer problems, and product development.
 



 You will:
 


* Investigate how AI engines respond to real customer questions.
* Diagnose why brands are represented the way they are and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Own communication and delivery for customer audits.
* Work closely with the founder to convert recurring customer problems into product improvements.



  





**Who we're looking for** 




 You'll likely do well in this role if you:
 


* Are naturally curious and enjoy understanding why systems behave the way they do.
* Form opinions based on evidence rather than intuition alone.
* Can communicate complex ideas with clarity.
* Are comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow.
* Enjoy working through ambiguity instead of waiting for complete information.



  





 Experience in product, consulting, research, analytics, client delivery, B2B SaaS, SEO, digital marketing, or experimentation with LLMs is valuable, but the ability to think clearly and learn quickly matters more.
 



  





**Your first 90 days** 




 During your first few months, you'll learn the platform by working directly on customer audits and deliveries. Over time, you'll begin leading engagements independently, contributing to product specifications, and helping shape the future direction of the platform.
 



  





 This role is designed as the starting point of our product function, with a clear path toward
 **Product Manager II** 
 as your scope and ownership increase.
 



  





**What you'll get** 



* Direct mentorship from the founder.
* Meaningful ownership from your first week.
* The opportunity to work on an emerging category at the intersection of AI, search, and commerce.
* A product used by paying customers across India and the US.
* A clear growth path within the product organization.



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply through
 **LinkedIn Easy Apply** 
 .
 



 You can also email your application to
 **annaninan@kasparro.com** 
 , CC
 **grandmaster@kasparro.com** 
 .

description:

 Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai (with regular travel to Khalapur Manufacturing Facility)**
**About KAIN**
 KAIN Cosmeceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's fastest\-growing contract manufacturing companies specializing in skincare, haircare, body care and colour cosmetics. We partner with some of the country's leading beauty brands to transform ideas into commercially successful products through innovation, speed and manufacturing excellence.
   

  

 Our Management Trainee Program is designed to develop future Product Managers and Business Development leaders by providing hands\-on exposure across the complete product commercialization journey.
   

  

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Management Trainee, you will work closely with the Product, Business Development, R\&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Procurement teams to support the development and launch of innovative beauty and personal care products.
   

  

 This is a high\-learning role offering direct exposure to customer interactions, product innovation, manufacturing operations and strategic business initiatives.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Product Development
   

  

 \- Support end\-to\-end new product development from concept to commercial launch.
   

 \- Prepare product briefs based on customer requirements and market opportunities.
   

 \- Conduct trend analysis, competitive benchmarking and ingredient research.
   

 \- Coordinate product trials with R\&D and Manufacturing teams.
   

 \- Track development timelines and ensure timely project execution.
   

  

**Business Development**
 \- Assist in preparing customer presentations, quotations and commercial proposals.
   

 \- Participate in customer meetings and understand project requirements.
   

 \- Maintain customer communication and follow up on ongoing projects.
   

 \- Support lead generation and business opportunity tracking.
   

  

**Project Management**
 \- Coordinate with Procurement, Planning, Quality, Regulatory and Production teams.
   

 \- Monitor project milestones and communicate updates internally.
   

 \- Ensure smooth execution from development through commercial production.
   

  

**Market \& Consumer Insights**
 \- Monitor emerging beauty trends, consumer behaviour and competitor launches.
   

 \- Identify innovation opportunities for customers and internal product platforms.
   

 \- Build reports and presentations to support business decisions.
   

  

**Documentation \& Reporting**
 \- Maintain project trackers and product databases.
   

 \- Prepare costing summaries, launch reports and commercial documentation.
   

 \- Develop customer presentations and product recommendation decks.
   

  

  

  

**Qualifications**
 \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in:
   

 \- B.Pharm
   

 \- B.Tech (Chemical, Biotechnology or related disciplines)
   

 \- B.Sc / M.Sc (Chemistry or Life Sciences)
   

 \- Cosmetic Science
   

 \- MBA (Marketing or Operations)
   

  

 Fresh graduates and candidates with up to 2 years of experience are encouraged to apply.
   

  

  

  

**Desired Skills**
 \- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
   

 \- Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
   

 \- High level of ownership and willingness to learn.
   

 \- Strong presentation and documentation skills.
   

 \- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
   

 \- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
   

 \- Passion for beauty, skincare, haircare and consumer brands.
   

  

  

  

**What You'll Learn**
 \- Product Management
   

 \- New Product Development (NPD)
   

 \- Business Development
   

 \- Key Account Management
   

 \- Cosmetic Manufacturing
   

 \- Supply Chain \& Procurement
   

 \- Commercial Costing
   

 \- Consumer Insights \& Market Research
   

 \- Cross\-functional Project Management

 \- Product Executive / Business Development Executive
   

 \- Senior Product Executive
   

 \- Assistant Product Manager / Key Account Manager
   

 \- Product Manager / Business Development Manager

 \- Collaborate with leading beauty and personal care brands.
   

 \- Accelerated career growth based on performance.
   

 \- Dynamic, entrepreneurial and innovation\-driven work environment.
   

 \- Opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Innovate in Bengaluru**
 This position is based at our on\-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting\-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on\-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.
   

  

**About Lowe's**
 Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 50 home improvement company serving approximately 17 million customer transactions a week in the U.S. With total fiscal year 2022 sales of over $97 billion, approximately $92 billion of sales were generated in the U.S., where Lowe's operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing and helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts.
   

  

 For more information, visit
 **Lowes.com**
**About Lowe's India**
 At Lowe's India, we are the enablers who help create an engaging customer experience for our $97 billion home improvement business at Lowe's. Our 4,000\+ associates work across Technology, Analytics, Business Operations, Finance \& Accounting, Product Management, and Shared Services. We leverage new technologies and find innovative methods to ensure that Lowe's has a competitive edge in the market.
   

  

 To know more about Lowe's India, visit
 **Lowes.co.in**
**About The Team**
 Our team brings together technology and business partners who genuinely enjoy building great products together. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, with product, engineering, design, and business teams partnering closely to turn ideas into meaningful outcomes. Across regions, we stay connected through shared goals, open communication, and a strong sense of teamwork. It’s a supportive, high\-energy environment where diverse perspectives are valued and people show up for one another. This is a chance to join a team that cares deeply about impact, partnership, and building the future together.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Product Manager is responsible for defining and delivering the vision, strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities for an assigned product or product area. This role translates customer, business, and stakeholder needs into clear product requirements, user stories, measurable objectives, and prioritized work for cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Working closely with engineering, design, analytics, business partners, and product leadership, the Product Manager guides products and features through the development lifecycle, leads agile planning activities, and makes informed trade\-off decisions to maximize customer and business value. The role also establishes product success metrics, monitors product health and performance, and uses data and customer insights to improve the user experience, drive adoption, and support broader portfolio and organizational goals.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Build OKRs for the product scope to support product portfolio and organizational OKRs, and drive alignment with business partners.
* Own the customer/user journey for a given product or feature and make decisions that impact feature usability with engineering.
* Define and measure customer success metrics to ensure the product scope supports overall product OKRs.
* Articulate how product features relate to the product vision and build a roadmap for stakeholders.
* Lead Agile ceremonies and provide clarity on expectations while aligning workstreams across team members.
* Prioritize and ensure the delivery, support, and execution of a high\-quality product.
* Partner with Product Managers and business leaders to evaluate trade\-offs and prioritize features aligned with the overall product vision.
* Work with Product Leadership to provide input on engineering priorities within the defined product space.
* Participate in product marketing activities to drive understanding of the product among peers and leaders.
* Drive product plans and leverage data to support alignment and decision\-making.
* Define functional and technical objectives, along with analytics requirements for the product.
* Establish product KPIs and consistently monitor product health and business impact.
* Partner with engineering teams to build tracking and monitoring systems required for product analytics.


**Years Of Experience**
* 2 years of experience in two or more of the following:
+ Product Management
+ Project Management
+ Business Analysis
+ Program Management
+ Experimentation
+ Product Marketing

* 1 year of experience in Product and/or Experience Management.


**Education Qualification**
**Required Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education, if applicable.
* Experience in an Agile software environment with strong writing ability.
* Experience working cross\-functionally in a large organization.
* Experience working closely with senior leadership.
* Experience translating data into quantifiable actions and deliverables.


**Required Skill Set**
**Primary Skills (Must Have)**
* Product strategy, vision, and roadmap development
* Product lifecycle and feature management
* OKR definition, alignment, and measurement
* Product backlog ownership and prioritization
* Agile product development and ceremony leadership
* User story and product requirements development
* Customer journey and user experience management
* Cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder alignment
* Data\-driven product decision\-making
* Product analytics, success metrics, and product health monitoring
* Collaboration with engineering and technical teams
* Feature trade\-off analysis and delivery execution


**Secondary Skills (Desired)**
* Product marketing and product adoption
* Business analysis and process improvement
* Project and program management
* Customer research and usability testing
* Experimentation and outcome validation
* Competitive and market analysis
* Executive communication and presentation
* Relationship and expectation management
* Technical and functional requirements definition
* Analytics tracking and monitoring implementation
* Change management
* Strong written and verbal communication


**Your Impact**
 The Product Manager owns the vision and strategy, roadmap, and feature definition for individual products within a product group. Responsibilities include writing stories to define outcomes and product requirements as well as planning and managing product features through the product development process. This role manages the product backlog while prioritizing work and making product\-related decisions based on the needs and expectations of customers and stakeholders. Finally, this role will focus on identifying key gaps in product features, capturing product requirements, and defining outcomes or objectives and key results (OKRs).
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Builds OKRs for product scope to support product portfolio and organizational OKRs and drives alignment with business partners.
* Owns customer/user journey for a given product/feature level. Makes decisions that impact user experience on feature usability with engineering.
* Defines and measures customer success metrics to ensure the product scope supports the overall product OKRs.
* Articulates how product features relate to the product vision and builds a roadmap for all partners.
* Leads agile ceremonies and works with the team to provide clarity of expectations. Aligns necessary workstreams from team members to achieve the value of their product.
* Prioritizes and ensures the delivery, support, and execution of a high\-quality product.
* Works with other product managers and business leaders to understand trade\-offs and prioritization of features based on overall product vision. Influences feature design trade\-offs to drive critical/mass adoption.
* Works with product leadership and provides input for engineering priorities of their defined product space.
* Participates in product marketing and uses it to drive deep understanding of the product they own with peers and leaders.
* Drives product plans for their defined product space and leverages data to help drive alignment.
* Defines objectives (functional and technical) and data required for analytics needed either independently or in conjunction with business partners for their product. Defines key metrics of the product and consistently monitors the health of the product and business impact.
* Partners with engineering teams to build tracking/monitoring systems needed to get to the data.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, engineering, communications, or related field or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable
* 2 years of experience in two or more of the following: project management, product management, business analysis, program management, experimentation, or product marketing
* 1 year of experience in product and/or experience management
* Experience in an agile software environment with strong writing ability
* Experience working cross\-functionally in a large organization
* Experience working closely with senior leadership
* Experience translating data into quantifiable actions/deliverables


**Preferred Skills/Education**
* Master’s degree in business administration or similar advanced degree

title: Product Manager
description:
The Role
   

  

 As Product Manager at TerraTern, you will own key user journeys across our platform – from discovering TerraTern to onboarding, engagement, and conversion. You’ll be responsible for defining problems, shaping solutions, and making sure the product you ship moves the right metrics for both users and the business.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Own and prioritise the product roadmap for specific user journeys (discovery, onboarding, engagement, and conversion).
* Convert user insights, market understanding, and business needs into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Engineering and Design to build intuitive, high‑quality experiences on web and mobile.
* Drive experimentation and data‑driven improvements on key metrics such as activation, engagement, retention, and revenue.
* Use analytics, user interviews, and feedback from counsellors and sales teams to iterate on features and inform future bets.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Operations to ensure launches are well‑aligned with how TerraTern acquires, serves, and retains users.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 2–5 years of core Product Management experience in B2C digital products (ed‑tech, consumer internet, fintech, or similar).
* Strong product thinking with a data‑driven decision‑making approach and comfort with experimentation.
* Proven experience owning a product or major feature end‑to‑end, from problem discovery to launch and iteration.

title: Technical Project Manager - I
description:
**Technical Project Manager \- I** 




  





 Exxat is a US\-headquartered SaaS company building technology that powers Health Sciences education at leading universities. Our cloud\-based platform brings together clinical education, curriculum management, compliance, scheduling, and academic operations into a single, integrated solution.
 



 The Technical Project Manager\-I (TPM\-I) is responsible for managing end\-to\-end project delivery, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements. The role partners closely with Engineering, Product, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver projects on time while managing scope, risks, and dependencies. TPM\-I drives the day\-to\-day execution cadence, including Agile ceremonies, stakeholder communication, and project tracking, while building the technical and delivery expertise required to manage larger, more complex initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Plan, execute, and deliver technical projects from initiation to completion.
* Own project scope, timelines, milestones, and delivery for a single workstream.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, and IT teams to define project objectives and deliverables.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Track project status, identify risks and dependencies, and drive timely resolution.
* Coordinate execution across 1–2 Engineering and QA teams



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant discipline.
* 3–5 years of experience in technical project management or related roles, preferably in a SaaS or product\-based software company.
* Working knowledge of SDLC and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
* Basic understanding of technical architecture and system design.
* Strong stakeholder communication and task prioritization skills.
* Familiarity with Generative AI tools to improve productivity and automate workflows.
* PMP or any other equivalent certification is an advantage

description:
**Quick Facts About the Role** 



* **Role:** 
 Project Manager
* **Location:** 
 Coimbatore
* **YOE:** 
 3 \- 5 years
* **Skills:** 
 Expertise in project management methodologies, Agile methodologies, Scrum techniques, stakeholder management, and client interaction.
* **Benefits:** 
 Learn more about our perks below.
* **Compensation:** 
 Competitive compensation as per industry standards.



  





**Who we are** 




 We are Foxsense Innovations \- a bunch of passionate developers that love solving complex business problems through products and tools we build from scratch. Weʼve been at it for over 7 years now, and weʼve serviced over 50 happy customers around the world, while also building several in\-house micro\-SaaS tools for the market (all of this while being bootstrapped and profitable). Our team is rapidly growing, and weʼre in an exciting phase of our 1\-10 journey. This is an opportunity for anyone who wants to experience this journey with us.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We seek a project manager to handle our company’s ongoing projects. You will work closely with your team members to ensure that all project requirements, deadlines, and schedules are on track. Responsibilities include submitting project deliverables, preparing status reports, establishing effective project communication plans, and properly executing said plans.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Coordinating with cross\-discipline team members to ensure all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules.
* Meeting with project team members to identify and resolve issues.
* Submitting project deliverables and ensuring that they adhere to quality standards.
* Preparing status reports by gathering, analyzing, and summarizing relevant information.
* Establish effective project communication plans and ensure their execution.
* Facilitating change requests to ensure that all parties are informed of the impacts on schedule and budget.
* Identifying and developing new opportunities with clients.
* Obtaining customer acceptance of project deliverables.
* Managing customer satisfaction within the project transition period.
* Conducting post\-project evaluation and identifying successful and unsuccessful project elements.
* Prepare requirement documents, user flows and validate test cases.



  





**Requirements** 



* A bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in a related field.
* 3\+ years experience in project management in the Technology industry
* Ability to lead project teams of various sizes and see them through to completion.
* Ability to manage clients and expectations.
* Strong understanding of formal project management, agile methodologies and stakeholder management.
* Able to complete projects in a timely manner.
* Strong communication and literary skills.



  





**Bonus Skills** 



* Basic understanding of coding, APIs, or cloud infrastructure to facilitate seamless communication with technical teams.
* Mastery of Agile methodologies to quickly adapt to changing priorities and drive project execution efficiently in a dynamic environment.



  





**Why work with us** 




 When you work with Foxsense Innovations, you donʼt just work a boring job. Our goal is to create a work environment that makes you want to brag about your work to your friends!
 



***Hereʼs why youʼll love working with us:***



* Unlimited sick leave policy, and a generous paid leave plan to ensure you get time off work whenever you need it
* A competitive and rewarding start\-up culture that motivates you from day one, along with regular team\-building activities
* Delicious lunch along with snacks and refreshments at office, so that hunger pangs never affect your A\-game
* We have a yearly annual retreat for the team to unwind and enjoy \- we went to Vagamon last year, who knows where we go this year!



**If that's not enough, there's always more!** 



* Need a breather? Game with Foxes at the TT. There's a scoreboard!
* Our wholesome health care plans care for you \- whenever, wherever.
* Embrace growth! Learn \& grow from peers \- You'll find budding freshers, seasoned veterans \- you name it.
* We take unwinding as seriously as we do hustling \- game nights are our way of downtime.
* Collaboration is vital for us \- your value isn’t limited to your responsibilities! Feel free to lurk in other departments and share your thoughts!



**Weʼre glad youʼve made it this far! If you’re passionate about delivering successful projects, fostering collaboration, and driving growth in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.**

title: FBS Scrum Master I
description:
Exhibits the fundamental qualities of a servant leader and demonstrates the fundamental principles and benefits of the Agile framework in an effort to improve team performance in the areas of quality, predictability, flow and velocity. Assists teams in meeting their delivery goals through enforcing team working agreements; communication techniques, coordination and cooperation; identifying and eliminating impediments; and ongoing coaching and development.
   

  

 Acts as a servant leader for a single team and stakeholders. Aids the team and Product Owner in efforts to manage and sequence the backlog. Leads less complex teams with work contained with limited external team impact or dependencies. Works generally with internal systems involving few system integration points requiring occasional support from senior level Scrum Master. Eliminates impediments and resolves issues with frequent support from Release Train Engineer or other resources. Resolves and manages dependencies with frequent guidance from Release Train Engineer or other resources to support team improvement and promotes high performance. Manages team performance in the areas of quality, predictability, flow and velocity and identifies SAFe anti\-patterns and resolve with frequent support. Utilizes beginner coaching capabilities to influence the team and help coach on practices and procedures. With frequent support from RTE guides the team through the decision making process and teach techniques on how to problem solve, improve communication, self\-manage and self\-organize. With frequent support from RTE Scrum Master, builds a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised. Help manages interpersonal conflicts, challenges and opportunities for growth within the team. Participates, facilitates and manages the outputs of all agile ceremonies including daily Stand Up meetings, Sprint review, sprint r etrospective, sprint planning, backlog refinement sessions, prepare for Program Increment Planning Sessions. Participates in the Scrum Mastery Sync Sessions and Agile Release Train Sync Sessions. Demonstrates ongoing desire for knowledge and continuous improvement by pursuing continuous education with regards to everything Agile (e.g. visit user groups, attend conferences, read books, write blogs, etc.). Continuously works with the Scrum Master Community of Practice to ensure standard procedures are in place and ultimately improve the organizations' product delivery capability. Seeks advice and works closely with other Scrum Masters and Release Train Engineers to establish best practices and resolve challenging issues, risks, conflicts or impediments. Performs other duties as assigned.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Communication skills \- Intermediate

 Microsoft Tools \- Entry Level (1\-3 Years)

In oncology, hematology, immunology, and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology.  We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care.
   

  

 As a Scrum Master I for the
 **Commercialization Content Capabilities team** 
 based out of our BMS Hyderabad you are part of the Commercialization IT team that builds best in class marketing solutions to help our customers with the capabilities that help accelerate the solutions for marketers to use.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing the agile development process of products by facilitating communication and collaboration between the development team, stakeholders, and product owners. The role involves working with cross\-functional teams to ensure that marketing tool / products are delivered on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Facilitating agile processes Facilitating agile processes for the development team, including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Managing the backlog Managing the product backlog, ensuring that it is up\-to\-date and prioritized based on stakeholder needs and requirements.

* Facilitating communication Facilitating communication and collaboration between the development team, stakeholders, and product owners to ensure that everyone is aligned on project goals, timelines, and requirements
* Managing risks Identifying and managing risks that may impact project delivery and proactively communicating these risks to stakeholders.

* Prior experience working in an Agile/Product based environment
* Provides strategic feedback to vendors on service delivery and balances workload with vendor teams


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 3\+ years proven working experience as a scrum master or as an agile Project Manager
* Hands on experience in managing, timelines, issue, risks is a must.
* 1\-2 years of technology product development exposure is preferred.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based data technologies on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform would be a plus.
* Must also have a strong attention to detail and be able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills Functional knowledge or prior experience in Lifesciences Research and Development domain is a plus

Visit careers.bms.com/eeo\-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

description:
We're looking for a dedicated Scrum Master to facilitate Agile practices and drive successful project delivery across the organization. This role has a specific twist: you'll need to build out large waterfall timelines with full delivery phases, then execute against them using Scrum Master ceremonies. If you're comfortable operating at the intersection of structured waterfall planning and Agile execution, this role is built for that.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring they're effective and productive
* Identify and remove obstacles impeding team progress, working with team members and stakeholders to resolve issues
* Champion Agile principles and methodologies, providing coaching and guidance to team members and stakeholders
* Build out large waterfall timelines with full delivery phases, then execute against them using Scrum ceremonies
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive team environment with open communication
* Monitor and report on sprint and project progress using Agile tools to track performance and identify improvement areas
* Lead the team in identifying and implementing process improvements
* Collaborate with product owners, development teams, and stakeholders to ensure alignment on goals and priorities
* Facilitate communication between the team and stakeholders to maintain transparency and shared understanding

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent certification

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. As a part of the team, you will deliver technology stack, using strong analytical and problem solving skills to understand the business requirements and deliver quality solutions. This will be done in conjunction with fellow engineers, business analysts and business stakeholders.

* All agile events like Sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

* Expert in Agile Practices and methodologies and help teams to adopt them.
* Foster Collaboration, Build trust, encourage transparency, and promote shared problem\-solving.
* Monitor Performance. Track metrics like velocity and burndown charts to guide improvements.
* Enable Tooling, Support automation, and reporting tools to streamline workflows.
* Practice empathy, stewardship, and community building.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
* Ability to mentor and guide junior team members.
* Collaborative mindset with a focus on team success.

 This role will be based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. **Accountabilities**

 Office

 As a Senior Technical Writer at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll create clear, comprehensive documentation for complex scientific products and software platforms. Working in a collaborative environment, you'll make cutting\-edge technology accessible to customers across life sciences, healthcare, and research fields. This role offers the opportunity to blend technical expertise with creative communication skills while contributing to innovations that help make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams of scientists, engineers, product managers, and subject matter experts to translate complex technical information into clear, user\-friendly content that enhances the customer experience.
   

  

**Job Duties**
 Your contribution as Technical Writer relies on extensive experience in four chief functions:
   

  

**Develop and deliver technical content**
* Define content strategies and architecture at the portfolio level for sophisticated, specialized publications.
* Conduct interviews, research, observe, and work hands\-on to capture and synthesize source material.
* Architect customer\-facing content using a variety of multimedia options appropriate to specific purposes and audiences.
* Design and perform user research to define our audiences and evaluate the effectiveness of our team's work.


**Manage projects**
* Lead the implementation of new publication workflows and processes at our local site.
* Help develop, communicate, and manage project plans for new functional initiatives.
* Provide transparency to all elements of a project to leadership, collaborators, and resources.


**Analyze business processes**
* Collaborate on crafting solutions to improve our ways of working in support of our strategic vision and road map.
* Work with internal business partners to gather information, requirements, and priorities and provide input to our project planning and decision\-making processes.


**Mentor and coach teammates**
* Train and counsel less experienced technical communicators and project teammates on effective technical communication practices, departmental software, and our functional processes.


**Education**
 BS/BA in a writing\- or science\-related field, or the equivalent combination of experience and education.
   

  

**Experience And Knowledge**
* 12\+ years of technical writing experience.
* Professional experience in electron microscopy, life sciences, or related scientific field.
* Solid experience working within Agile software development environments.
* Sophisticated knowledge of structured authoring and single\-sourcing, particularly using Madcap Flare and other XML\-based authoring tools.
* Detailed experience with GitLab, HTML, and CSS.
* Successful project leadership in cross\-functional, cross\-cultural international work teams.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a history of developing positive relationships.
* Proficiency in English, both verbal and written.
* Demonstrated attention to detail.
* Reliably self\-motivated and comfortable working independently.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Junior Full\-Stack Engineer
 
  




 About us
 
 Serein is one of the fastest\-growing innovators in the e\-learning space. More than 500 organisations across 35 countries rely on our platform to train employees and leaders, helping them build safer workplaces, collaborate better, and boost productivity.
 



  





 We are on a mission to make learning at work simple, impactful, and human.
 



  





 We’re a globally distributed team with people across India, the UK, Spain, and beyond – and we build the same way we think: without unnecessary boundaries.
 



 If you’re excited by the idea of shaping how the world learns, this is your chance to join a company that’s scaling fast, thinks boldly, and builds with purpose.
 


 About the role
 
 This is a hands\-on, build\-and\-learn role for someone early in their career who wants to grow fast in a real product environment. You will work across Serein’s marketing site and our customer\-facing learning platform – building landing pages, maintaining web properties, and contributing to a product used by 500\+ organisations across 35 countries.
 



  





 You don’t need to know everything. You need to be hungry to learn, comfortable getting your hands dirty with unfamiliar technology, and sharp enough to pick things up quickly. We will invest in your growth if you invest in the work.
 



 Web development \& marketing site
 


* Build and maintain pages on Serein’s marketing site (WordPress \+ Elementor), extending them with custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript where needed.
* Work with the marketing and design teams to turn mockups and Figma files into clean, responsive pages that look great on desktop and mobile.
* Help build campaign pages, landing pages, and other web experiences that are fast, polished, and on\-brand.



 Platform support \& content
 


* Work on Serein’s customer\-facing learning platform — frontend tasks, bug fixes, and small feature additions under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Collaborate with the content team to publish, structure, and improve learning content delivered through the LMS.
* Write clean, readable code and ask good questions when you’re stuck.



 Learning and growing
 


* Pick up new technologies as the work demands – we work across the stack and you will too, gradually.
* Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
* Grow into owning features end\-to\-end as your confidence and experience build.


 You have
 * 0–2 years of professional experience. Internship or freelance experience counts. Strong side projects can make up for less time in the industry.
* A solid grasp of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — you’ve built things with them, not just completed tutorials.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one frontend framework (React, Vue, Svelte — we don’t have a strong preference).
* Some exposure to backend development — Node.js, Django, PHP, or anything similar. You don’t need to be deep in it, but you’ve written server\-side code before.
* You’ve touched a relational database (MySQL, PostgreSQL — anything SQL). You know what a query looks like and roughly why it matters.
* Comfortable using Git, a terminal, and running code in environments that aren’t your laptop.
* Clear communicator, low ego, and genuinely curious about how things work.


 Why should you join us?
 
 At Serein, you’ll get something most junior roles don’t offer: real responsibility from day one, with senior guidance close by. You won’t be writing unit tests in a corner — you’ll be shipping pages that real users see, working on a platform with real customers, and learning across the full stack. This is an early hire at a pivotal moment in our growth, which means the ceiling on what you can own and learn is unusually high. If you want to grow fast and build things that matter, this is that role.
